notes.text: SALARY MODEL: the CCNL Grafica e Editoria Industria (G011) uses a split model with separate paga base (TEM), contingenza (frozen since 1992 per Prot. 31/07/1992), and EDR (10.33 EUR, all levels). The base_salary values in this file are the TOTAL (paga base + contingenza + EDR) per level and tranche, sourced from the official lexplain.it table (all 5 tranches) and kitech.it (July 2026 breakdown). Modeling the total as base_salary produces the same gross_monthly as the split representation. fixed_allowances is empty for all levels (no additional fixed components).

CONGLOBATED CHECK: inter-level increase ratios are stable across all 5 tranches (e.g., Q/E = 1.937, C1/E = 1.357 at all dates), confirming a single parametric coefficient system. Contingenza is frozen per level (E=512.87, Q=539.99); EDR=10.33 uniform. Total values from lexplain cross-check with kitech July 2026 breakdown to within ±0.03 EUR (rounding difference).

HOURLY DIVISOR: 173. G011 CCNL states orario normale 40 ore medie settimanali (confirmed conflavoro.it CCNL text and ilccnl.it). Formula 40×52/12=173.33→173. Daily divisore convenzionale 26 confirmed by lavoro-economia.it. The exact contractual divisore clause was not retrieved directly from primary text, but the 40h/week is unambiguous; divisor 173 is the correct derived value.

TRANCHE DATES: 01.03.2024, 01.09.2024, 01.05.2025, 01.10.2025, 01.07.2026. Values from rinnovo 20.12.2024 (retroactive application). Fonte: lexplain.it (5 tranches, all 12 Grafici levels) and kitech.it (componenti breakdown July 2026).

SENIORITY: 5 scatti biennali (24 months), amounts from kitech.it July 2026. The scatto amounts of the previous rinnovo were not recovered: each amount series declares a 'missing' gap from 2024-03-01 to 2026-07-01. A run before July 2026 with increments due raises MissingRuleError; a run with no increment due does not read the amount.

limitation.remediation: Recover the scatto amounts of the previous rinnovo for periods before July 2026.

notes.text: SECTOR SCOPE: models the GRAFICI (graphics workers) sector only (12 levels: E, D2, D1, C2, C1, B3, B2, B1, B1S, A, AS, Q). The EDITORI (publishers) sector (9 levels: 8°-0°/Q) with slightly different pay tables is NOT modelled. Coverage marked as layer_1=implemented for Grafici only.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Confirmed by secondary source (lavoro-economia.it / contratticcnl.it). A quattordicesima is not provided for by CCNL G011 Grafici.
INPS: reuses 2026-industria.json (Confindustria). AIEG/Acigraf are members of Confindustria; CIGO applicable for the graphic arts industry sector (D.Lgs. 148/2015).

APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 26e, Type 2, CCNL 19/01/2021, p.42; confirmed in force in the 20.12.2024 renewal): 'triennale' track (groups C,B,A,Q → levels C2,C1,B3,B2,B1,B1S,A,AS,Q): 36 months / 6 semesters, 70/75/80/85/90/95% then 100%. 'biennale' track (group D → levels D2,D1): 24 months / 6 four-month periods (4 months each), 70/75/80/85/90/95% then 100%. Level E not listed as an apprenticeship destination. EDITORI sector not modelled in this JSON. Source: fistelcisl.it PDF CCNL grafici-editoriali.pdf (p. 41-42).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: LEVELS E, D2, A, AS: the file values exceed the sum of the printed items (minimo of 01/10/2022 + contingenza + EDR + cumulative TEM increments, FISTel compendium pp. 172, 176, 173, 19) by a constant amount at every tranche: E +14.74, D2 +16.77, A +30.81, AS +36.47, about one 2022 tranche. No signatory prints the post-2024 totals, so the values are kept from the aggregator and not verified.

limitation.remediation: Read a printed post-2024 table of the signatories (testo a stampa) and reconcile levels E, D2, A and AS.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Parte Terza (Impiegati), Art. 8 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 98): "Nel caso di inizio o cessazione del rapporto durante il corso dell’anno, l’impiegato non in prova avrà diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell’ammontare della 13a mensilità per quanti sono i mesi di servizio prestato. La frazione di mese non superiore a 15 giorni non sarà considerata, mentre sarà considerata come mese intero la frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: The base_salary (minimo + contingenza + EDR) of the twelve Grafici levels against the renewal of 19 December 2023 and the CCNL 19 January 2021 it amends.
findings: No signatory text prints the 2024-2026 Grafici totals. The signed ipotesi of 19/12/2023 (PDF p. 17) sets the B3 increments (Marzo 24 € 90, Ottobre 24 € 30, Maggio 25 € 30, Ottobre 25 € 50, Luglio 26 € 52) to be riparametrati and keeps contingenza and EDR unchanged; p. 19 (also printed by SLC-FISTel-UILCOM national secretariats on 11/01/2024) gives the per-level increments; the CCNL 2021 printed text gives the minimi at 01/10/2022 (p. 172), contingenza (p. 176) and EDR 10,33 (p. 173). The file's base_salary is the total minimo + contingenza + EDR, so each value is derived as that sum.
The file's second tranche starts 2024-09-01, but the ipotesi and the increment table date it October 2024: the 12 periods of 2024-09-01 are left unbacked and should be moved to 2024-10-01.

Levels Q, B1S, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2, D1: the 32 periods of 2024-03-01, 2025-05-01, 2025-10-01 and 2026-07-01 are derived; the file values were 0-3 cents higher (aggregator rounding) and 25 are corrected.

Levels E, D2, A, AS: the file exceeds the derived sum by a constant 14.74-14.77 (E), 16.77-16.79 (D2), 30.81-30.83 (A), 36.47-36.49 (AS) at every tranche. These 16 periods are left unbacked pending a printed table; the derived values are in each reason.
The file's meta lists the signatories as AIEG and Acigraf; the texts are signed by Assografici, AIE and ANES with SLC-CGIL, FISTel-CISL and UILCOM-UIL (CNEL G011).

provenance.transformation: Employer 1.9% of the retribuzione contrattuale annua for a worker without the ERC, from 1.1.2024. The retribuzione contrattuale annua is the pay of the CCNL tables, the minimum (paga base, contingenza and EDR, the totals of this file) and the scatti, over the twelve months and the tredicesima: the TFR base of the engine, which on this CCNL (no allowance on any level) holds the pay chain, the tredicesima and the deductions of unpaid absences, not overtime or bonuses.
